entry_sequence.action: Wait for a sharp down move into a well-defined intraday support level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The move into support is often preceded by a moment where volume stalls and sellers hesitate to push their hand, signifying a turn of momentum.

entry_sequence.action: Take the offer and get long in front of that support level.
entry_sequence.rationale: The bids at the support level are used as protection while seeking to capture the bounce off that level.

stop.rationale: The bids at the support level are used as protection.

confluences.name: in_play_stock_selection
confluences.description: The stock must be an in-play name, meaning it has a significant price range, is doing high volume, and often trading on a news catalyst or interesting technical pattern.

confluences.name: tight_level_alignment
confluences.description: Identify a very well-defined intraday support or resistance level, ideally one that aligns on multiple time frames.

confluences.name: order_flow_disparity
confluences.description: Pay attention to how thick or thin the bids and offers are, and look for disparity as well as which side is being more aggressive.

speaker_concepts.verbatim_description: A stock that has a significant price range, is doing high volume, and often trading on a news catalyst or interesting technical pattern.
I want a very well-defined intraday support or resistance level. Ideally, one that aligns on multiple time frames.
You need to be paying attention to how thick or thin the bids and offers are, and look for disparity as well as which side is being more aggressive.
Occur after price stretches too far too fast. You are stepping in when emotion peaks and order flow begins to shift.
Occur around breaks of clean support or resistance. When scalping here, you are trying to be the first market participant to enter upon the break.

Instead of aggressively taking liquidity, you provide the liquidity... with the aim to capture the difference between the spread as other participants are crossing and hitting the bid and paying the offer.

entry_sequence.action: Wait for a clean support or resistance level to be broken.
entry_sequence.rationale: The goal is to be the first market participant to enter upon the break.

entry_sequence.action: Enter long (buy) or short (sell) on the break and scalp out on the emotional follow-through.
entry_sequence.rationale: Success depends heavily on timing and confirmation from real-time order flow.

stop.rationale: The stop loss would be right below that level if it gets back below the $50.
